newsitem.title: USA: TransAct in marketing pact with IPL Datron.
newsitem.headline: TransAct in marketing pact with IPL Datron.

text.p: TransAct Technologies Inc said Monday it had entered into an exclusive, five-year sales and marketing agreement with IPL Datron Pty Ltd of Australia.
IPL will market and sell TransAct's point-of-transaction products throughout Australia, New Zealand and certain island countries in the South Pacific region, TransAct said.
TransAct said it will supply its products on an as-ordered basis.
TransAct designs, develops, manufacturers and markets transaction-based printers and related products under the ITHACA and MAGNETEC brand names.
